title: mc-test results.json
description: Structured, typed run report written beside the JUnit XML (docs/CI.md; spec commandcenter/40-testing-loop.md §6). One object per `mc-test run` invocation: run-level totals + one entry per case. A 'case' here is one (test x target) cell — the matrix engine (spec §4) will later expand `config` with per-dimension values; until then `config` carries the target identity only.

declared.description: Total cases declared for this run (before any skip). Equals `executed` until the matrix engine (spec §4) can declare cases it never runs.

executed.description: Cases actually run (steps executed) — includes passed/failed/errored, excludes cases that never started.

coverage_model.description: How `declared` was computed. 'flat': one case per (test x target), no matrix dimensions (pre-matrix-engine). Later values: 'full' | 'pairwise' (spec §4).

target.description: Comma-joined target id(s) this run covered.

sha.description: Git commit of the project under test (cwd at invocation time), best-effort. Absent when cwd is not a git checkout or git is unavailable.

config.description: The case's configuration. Pre-matrix-engine this is the target identity (target/loader/mc/driver); the matrix engine (spec §4) will add per-dimension bound values here.

failed_step.description: `<index>:<verb>` of the step that failed, when status is fail|error.

evidence.description: Artifact paths (screenshots, server logs) attached to this case, always present (possibly empty).

invariant_ref.description: Reference to the ratified invariant this case judges (spec §5). Not yet populated — no invariant DSL exists before the matrix engine (spec §9 phase 2).
